messages.subject: Keizersgracht unit — lease expiry 1 April, renewal options
messages.body:
Dear Ms Fischer,

Your current lease for the ground floor and first floor unit runs until 1 April 2026. For a renewal we can offer:

- 12 months at the current rate of EUR 6,200 per month, indexation deferred to the next term
- 24 months at EUR 6,350 per month with one rent-free month
- 12 months at EUR 5,900 per month for a reduced footprint (ground floor only)

Please let us know your preference before 13 February so we can prepare the addendum.

Kind regards,
Rob Verhoeven
VdB Vastgoedbeheer B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Keizersgracht unit — lease expiry 1 April, renewal options
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Forwarding the landlord's offer. My quick read:

- We still need the meeting rooms and desk setup for ~20 people, so ground-floor-only is too small
- The 24-month option saves one month's rent but ties us in longer than I'm comfortable with given the launch
- 12 months at the same €6,200 keeps everything simple — no moving costs, no fit-out, no downtime

I also checked coworking for comparison: hot desks for 15 people plus four meeting rooms came out around €7,800/month in Rotterdam Centrum, before the one-off move itself. So moving would cost us more, not less.

Danke,
Lena

messages.subject: RE: Keizersgracht unit — lease expiry 1 April, renewal options
messages.body:
Dear Marta, dear Lena,

I have reviewed the landlord's proposal and I would gently suggest that the 12-month renewal at the current €6,200 per month is the most prudent option available to us. Lena's coworking comparison confirms my own impression: a move would involve not only higher running costs but also roughly €4–5k of one-off fit-out, cabling and insurance transfer costs, which we would not recover within a year. Furthermore, with the v3 launch and the hosting migration both consuming cash this quarter, I would very much prefer to avoid any avoidable disruption to the office in the same period.

The 24-month option's single rent-free month is attractive on paper, but the €150/month uplift compounds to €3,600 over the term, which exceeds the value of the free month.

I therefore propose we proceed with the 12-month renewal, and I am happy to sign the addendum once Lena confirms the details with Mr Verhoeven.

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Keizersgracht unit — lease expiry 1 April, renewal options
messages.body:
12 months at 6200 sounds right. lena, go ahead.

M
Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: Keizersgracht unit — lease expiry 1 April, renewal options
messages.body:
Beste Rob,

We accept the 12-month renewal at €6,200/month. Please send the addendum for signature — Helen will countersign.

Danke,
Lena Fischer
Ops & Office Manager, Parcelwise B.V.
